context.working_title: Temporal Workflow with Go: Architecture & Production Determinism
context.business_outcome: Establish topical authority in distributed systems and microservices orchestration for Go developers.
context.audience: Senior Backend Engineers scaling microservices and dealing with complex distributed transactions/Sagas.

topical_authority.information_gain: Deep dive into Temporal's execution model (Event Sourcing), strict rules of Go determinism (no goroutines inside workflows), and real-world worker scaling configurations.

keywords.cannibalization_check: Distinct from '08-saga-pattern-distributed-transactions-go.md' which focuses entirely on the Saga pattern rather than Temporal's internal engine architecture.
keywords.serp_notes: Top results are Temporal's official docs. Lacks deep, experience-based production guides in Vietnamese for Go.

geo_aeo.answer_first_block: Temporal là một nền tảng orchestration cho microservices sử dụng mô hình Event Sourcing để đảm bảo workflow của bạn có thể phục hồi trạng thái sau khi crash. Trong Go, Temporal Workflow yêu cầu tính Determinism tuyệt đối (không dùng goroutine, rand, hay time native) để engine có thể replay lại chính xác trạng thái thực thi.
